summary.text: Rick Wilborn is a Republican member of the Kansas House of Representatives representing District 73 (McPherson County), and the Legislature's member page lists service in the House since 2025.
Rick Wilborn is listed as a vice chair of the Energy, Utilities and Telecommunications Committee.

paragraphs.text: According to the same page, Rick Wilborn served in the Senate (2015–2024) before the current service in the House that began in 2025.
Rick Wilborn is listed as a member of the Energy, Utilities and Telecommunications Committee, the Elections Committee and the Transportation Committee.
The Legislature lists Rick Wilborn's occupation as Self-employed.
The page names Pamela Wilborn as Rick Wilborn's spouse.
